name: jev-router
description: Asks TypeSafe Jev before each task which Claude model and effort fit best, then runs the turn on it

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: Key for api.typesafe.ai (Jev). Alternatives: TYPESAFE_API_KEY env var, or /jev key <key>

mode.title: Routing mode
mode.description: efficient: best result; balanced: quality vs cost; cheap: cheapest model that can succeed

models.title: Allowed Claude models
models.description: Aliases Jev may choose from: haiku, sonnet, opus, fable

stickiness.title: Cache stickiness
stickiness.description: off: always follow Jev; auto: while the prompt cache is warm, only upgrade on high confidence; strict: never switch while warm

minConfidence.title: Min confidence to upgrade
minConfidence.description: With stickiness auto, a warm-cache upgrade needs at least this Jev confidence

minContextTokens.title: Min context to protect
minContextTokens.description: Below this many context tokens a switch is free and stickiness is skipped

cacheTtlMs.title: Cache TTL (ms)
cacheTtlMs.description: Time after the last request when the prompt cache counts as cold

timeoutMs.title: Jev timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Keep the current model when Jev takes longer than this

effortCap.title: Effort cap
effortCap.description: Highest reasoning effort the router applies. Start a prompt with !full, or run /jev full, to lift it for one prompt

routeSteps.title: Route every step
routeSteps.description: Ask Jev again before each step of a task (the cache guard still applies). Off: one call per prompt

routeSubagents.title: Route subagents
routeSubagents.description: Pick a model and effort for each subagent from its task description

pauseMs.title: Pause after failures (ms)
pauseMs.description: After 3 failed Jev calls in a row, stop asking for this long and keep the current model

baselineModel.title: Savings baseline
baselineModel.description: The model the savings estimate compares against (what you would use without the router)

escalateAfter.title: Escalate after failures
escalateAfter.description: After this many failed tool calls in a row, move the rest of the task up one model. 0 turns it off

sendHistory.title: Send conversation history
sendHistory.description: Send the last messages to Jev for context. Off sends only the task text

redact.title: Redact secrets
redact.description: Replace API keys, tokens, private keys and KEY=value lines with [redacted] before anything is sent to Jev

maxTaskChars.title: Max task characters
maxTaskChars.description: How much of the prompt is sent to Jev

fallback.title: Fallback when Jev is down
fallback.description: session: keep the session model. heuristic: a crude local guess from the prompt length and a few words

ceiling.title: Model ceiling
ceiling.description: The most expensive model Jev may pick unless it is very sure (see ceilingBreak). none: no ceiling. sonnet is a good lean setting

floor.title: Model floor
floor.description: The cheapest model Jev may pick. none: no floor

ceilingBreak.title: Confidence to break the ceiling
ceilingBreak.description: Jev may exceed the ceiling only at or above this confidence (0 to 1)
